values.note: May 1-Sep 30 sites 1-13 need a permit from DEC's Lands and Forests Office, booked by phone or email (607-371-7268, M-F 8:00-3:45) from April 1; 'Sites generally are booked two weeks or more in advance.' Oct 1-Apr 30 the same sites are first-come, first-served with no reservation (a Forest Ranger permit for 4+ nights or 9+ people). At most 14 nights per calendar year on any one site or combination of sites; 8 people per permit; arrive after 1 pm, leave by 11 am.

booking.source: https://dec.ny.gov/places/hunts-pond-state-forest ('Primitive camping on sites 1-13 requires a permit from the Lands and Forests Office'; 'Please call 607-371-7268 or email ... to obtain a permit'; 'Reservations can be made beginning April 1'; 'Sites generally are booked two weeks or more in advance'; Oct. 1 - April 30 first-come, first-served; 'Maximum stay is 14 nights per calendar year on any one site or combination of sites'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: May 1-Sep 30 is the permit (reservation) season; the sites stay open first-come, first-served Oct 1-Apr 30. DEC says nothing about winter road maintenance on Hunts Pond Road.

season.source: https://dec.ny.gov/places/hunts-pond-state-forest ('May 1 - Sept. 30: A permit is required for sites 1-13'; 'Oct. 1 - April 30: Sites 1-13 are first-come, first-served'), read 2026-10-21. The stored 05-01/09-30 (note-derived) was the permit season, not a closing.

values.note: Sites 9-13 are tent only. A site takes two vehicles (motor homes included) or one registered camping trailer and two vehicles.

sites.source: https://dec.ny.gov/places/hunts-pond-state-forest ('13 sites (1-13)'; 'Sites 9-13 are tent camping only'; 'There is a two (2) vehicle limit (including motor homes) per camp site, or one (1) camping trailer with current registration and two (2) vehicles per campsite'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Two portable toilets during the on-season (the page says May 30 - Sep 30); each site has a fire ring.

facilities.source: https://dec.ny.gov/places/hunts-pond-state-forest ('There is no potable water source. Two (2) portable toilets are available for campers during the May 30 - September 30 on-season'), read 2026-10-21. vault_toilets (note-derived) cleared: DEC describes portable toilets, not vault toilets.

fees.source: https://dec.ny.gov/places/hunts-pond-state-forest ('Fee: Free'; no permit fee is mentioned), read 2026-10-21

note: DEC state forest, New Berlin: the former Hunts Pond State Park, with numbered sites on a gravel road along the pond. --Claude
summary: DEC's page: free, 13 sites (9-13 tent only), motor homes and camping trailers allowed on a site, no potable water, portable toilets in season. CHANGED: booking was 'not reservable, FCFS always' (derived) - sites 1-13 need a permit booked by phone/email from April 1 for May 1-Sep 30 and are first-come only Oct 1-Apr 30; season 05-01..09-30 was the permit season, the sites are open year-round; vault_toilets cleared (portable toilets); 14-night max added. Note trimmed of booking/fee/facility restatements and the wrong 'self-issue permit, first-come' text. Imagery shows a gravel road looping along the shore to the sites (drive-in); DEC states no rig length or road condition.
flags: Phone: stored 607-674-4017 is not on DEC's page; DEC gives the Region 7 Sherburne Office / Lands and Forests Office (permits) 607-371-7268.
Booking is by phone/email to a DEC office (no online system), and DEC says sites 'generally are booked two weeks or more in advance' in season.
